_about: Every way out of every place. Times are Fogg's own reckoning, as the novel narrates them, local and to the minute; the game's clock counts hours from 1872-10-02T20:45. A departure with 'departs' sails at that moment and is gone once the clock passes it; one without sails when taken and takes 'hours'. 'book' is true where the novel has it, with the chapter, and false where the game invented it, with the reason. 'approximate' marks a time the novel gives only roughly. 'ticket' opens the ticket office before leaving. 'cost' is in pounds, drawn from the carpet-bag.

departures.label: Take the mail train to Brindisi
Take tomorrow's mail train to Brindisi
departures.note: Invented: the same train a day later.

departures.label: Take the Dover mail by way of Calais and Marseilles
departures.note: Invented: a longer way across France, which misses the Mongolia.

departures.label: Sail on the Mongolia for Suez
Wait for the next steamer to Suez
departures.note: Invented: a weekly steamer, a week behind the Mongolia.

departures.label: Rejoin the Mongolia for Aden
Wait for the next steamer to Aden
departures.note: Invented: the following week's sailing.

departures.label: Rejoin the Mongolia for Bombay
Wait for the next steamer to Bombay
departures.note: Invented: the following week's sailing.

departures.label: Take the eight o'clock train for Calcutta
Take tomorrow's train for Calcutta
departures.note: Invented: the same train a day later.

departures.label: Ride Kiouni into the forest
Walk the fifty miles to Allahabad
departures.note: Invented: the choice the book's travellers were offered and refused.

departures.label: Wait for a bullock cart to Allahabad
departures.note: Invented: named in the plan as the game's own departure from the book.

departures.label: Ride Kiouni on to Allahabad
Take the midday train to Calcutta
Take the night train to Calcutta
departures.note: Invented: a later train, which misses the Rangoon.

departures.label: Sail on the Rangoon for Hong Kong
Wait for the next steamer to Hong Kong
departures.note: Invented: the following week's sailing.

departures.label: Rejoin the Rangoon for Hong Kong
Wait for the steamer after the Rangoon
departures.note: Invented: the following week's sailing.

departures.label: Sail on the Carnatic for Yokohama
departures.note: The translation has the Carnatic sail 'that very evening', the 6th, in chapter XIX and 'at half-past six on the 7th' in chapter XXII. The game takes the 6th, which agrees with Fogg arriving that day and missing her.

departures.label: Charter the Tankadere to Shanghai
departures.note: A hundred pounds a day and two hundred reward, as offered to John Bunsby; four days.

departures.label: Wait a week for the next steamer to Yokohama
departures.note: The book says the passengers for Japan would have waited a week for the next steamer.

departures.label: Take a coasting steamer to Shanghai
departures.note: Invented: a slower, cheaper way to Shanghai than the Tankadere.

departures.label: Board the American steamer for Yokohama
Take a Japanese steamer to Yokohama
departures.note: Invented: a Japanese coaster that reaches Yokohama a few hours before the General Grant sails.

departures.label: Sail on the General Grant for San Francisco
Take the mail steamer by way of Honolulu
departures.note: Invented: a slower Pacific crossing by the Sandwich Islands.

departures.label: Charter a steamer for San Francisco
departures.note: Invented: fast and dear, for a Route that missed the General Grant. Fifteen days, so that even after the week's wait at Hong Kong it reaches San Francisco in time for the special train east to make Omaha's last train; at four hundred hours it rescued nobody.

departures.label: Wait for the next Pacific Mail steamer
departures.note: Invented: a fortnight later, which is too late.

departures.label: Rejoin the mail steamer for San Francisco
departures.note: Invented: the mail steamer's second leg, a day behind the General Grant.

departures.label: Take a trading schooner to San Francisco
departures.note: Invented: under sail, and slower than the mail steamer.

departures.label: Take the Pacific Railroad for New York
Take the Pacific Railroad the next evening
departures.note: Invented: the same train a day later.

departures.label: Sail south for Panama
departures.note: Invented: the Pacific Mail's route by the isthmus.

departures.label: Charter a special train east
departures.note: Invented: straight through to Omaha, missing Salt Lake City and the attack at Fort Kearney. Eighty hours, about twenty-two miles an hour; at a hundred and ten, taken by anyone who reached San Francisco late, it arrived after Omaha's last train east.

departures.label: Rejoin the train eastward
Wait for the next train east
departures.note: Invented: the same train a day later.

departures.label: Sail by sledge to Omaha
departures.note: Mudge's sledge rigged like a sloop, over the frozen prairie.

departures.label: Wait for the next eastbound train
departures.note: Invented: the book's travellers would not wait for it.

departures.label: Ride with the army's wagons to Omaha
departures.note: Invented: slower than the sledge, with no sail to set.

departures.label: Take the train for Chicago and New York
Take the next train for Chicago and New York
departures.note: Invented: the next through train, which misses the China and the Henrietta.

departures.label: Take the Chicago express, changing for New York
departures.note: Invented: a faster express that reaches New York before the China sails.

departures.label: Cross the isthmus and sail for New York
departures.note: Invented: the Atlantic side of the isthmus route.

departures.label: Sail on the China for Liverpool
departures.note: The China sailed forty-five minutes before the train reached New York. Her arrival is the game's; the book never has her arrive.

departures.label: Take passage on the Henrietta
departures.note: Two thousand dollars a head for three, at the game's rate of five dollars to the pound.

departures.label: Wait for the next Cunard steamer
departures.note: Invented: the next sailing, two days after the China. It reaches London in time only if the Detective's warrant holds Fogg no more than a few hours, so the telegrams sent since Suez decide it.

departures.label: Sail on the Inman steamer for Queenstown
departures.note: Invented: the next Atlantic sailing, a day behind the Henrietta.

departures.label: Take the mail train and the boat to Liverpool
departures.note: By Dublin; reached Liverpool at twenty minutes before twelve on the 21st.

departures.label: Wait for the Liverpool packet
departures.note: Invented: slower than the mail train and the boat.

departures.label: Take a special train to London
departures.note: Six hours to London; the special reached it at ten minutes before nine.

departures.label: Take the ordinary express to London
departures.note: Invented: cheaper and a little slower than the special.
